along the Pacific Coast and through the San Francisco Bay,
respectively.

unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone

and NEVER turn your back on the ocean. Monitor local weather,
surf and tide forecasts at www.weather.gov/mtr.

river on Navajo Route 71 near Bird Springs will flood, and Leupp
will be within 3 feet of flooding problems. The river will crest
at Navajo Route 71 approximately 18 hours after the river crests
at Winslow. Minor lowland overflow on right bank at Winslow.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued November 3 at 8:20AM MST until November 5 at 5:15PM MST by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues along the
San Juan River from near Bluff to the terminus at Lake Powell.

* WHERE...Southwestern San Juan County in southeastern Utah...

* WHEN...Until 515 PM MST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...River levels continue to rise due to excess runoff from
Sunday's rainfall. Expect high water levels and the River exceeding
its banks, inundating low-lying areas along the San Juan River. A
prolonged period of high water is forecast, with a crest near 23.5
ft Thursday morning. It will take several hours for all the water
from these storms to work through local drainage systems.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 813 AM MST, stream gauge reports indicates the observed stage
on the San Juan River at Bluff has exceeded flood stage and is at
23.7 feet. Timing of additional crests is subject to change as
more details become available. Please continue to monitor the
forecast and updated  warnings.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
the San Juan River from Bluff to the terminus at Lake Powell.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.
